comment: AI was used to make this list. This list compares keywords against detected item names. If a keyword matches, the corresponding rule overrides Gemini's decision about TSA approval

rules.note: Explosives and fireworks are not allowed in carry-on or checked bags.
Firearms are never allowed in carry-ons. Checked bags only if unloaded, locked and declared.
Ammo is not allowed in carry-ons. Checked bags need special packaging.
Flammable fuel is not allowed in any bag.
Self-defense spray is not allowed in carry-ons. Checked bags: one small container with a safety cap.
Knives and blades are not allowed in carry-ons. Pack in your suitcase, sheathed.
Scissors with blades over 4 inches are not allowed in a carry-on.
Bats, clubs and heavy tools are not allowed in carry-ons. Pack in your suitcase.
Tools over 7 inches are not allowed in a carry-on.
Liquids over 3.4 oz (100 ml) are not allowed in a carry-on. Pack big bottles in your suitcase.
Aerosols are limited to 3.4 oz in a carry-on; large cans need to be non-flammable.
Spare lithium batteries and power banks must go in your carry-on, never your suitcase.
Vapes and e-cigarettes must go in your carry-on, not checked bags.
One small lighter is OK in a carry-on. Torch lighters are not allowed.
Safety matches are OK in a carry-on only. Strike-anywhere matches are not allowed.
Stun guns are not allowed in carry-ons. Checked bags only if batteries are removed.
Drones are allowed, but take the lithium batteries in your carry-on.
Snow globes are only allowed in carry-ons if small (under 3.4 oz of liquid).
